author: The Current
description:
Charlie Parr performs "(what's so funny about) Universal Healthcare?" live in studio for Radio Heartland
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Charlie Parr’s new album, Rooming House, started the way a lot of Parr’s music begins. “I write short stories that can be mined for songs,” he says. “That's kind of always how I felt about them.”

Inspired by the time he spent living in rooming houses when he first moved from Austin, Minnesota, to the Twin Cities several years ago, Parr was writing fictional narratives based on the people he met and the experiences he had while living communally. It wasn’t long before several songs emerged, and it became the album, Rooming House. It’s written and recorded to be listened to start to finish, like a concept album or an opera. Parr plans to eventually publish a book to accompany the album. And who knows? It might even become a movie.
